title: scValToNative merges ScMap keys that convert to the same native key and drops entries silently
severity_basis: Silent wrong value in a converted contract value (entries lost without an error). Fixed in 17.3.0 (it now throws); not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: either every map entry survives the conversion or the conversion fails
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: scValToNative returns an object with 2 key(s) and no error; the fix of the v17 line was not backported to v16.

entries.expected: either every map entry survives the conversion or the conversion fails
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: scValToNative returns an object with 1 key(s) and no error; the fix of the v17 line was not backported to v16.

entries.expected: either every map entry survives the conversion or the conversion fails
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: scValToNative returns an object with 1 key(s) and no error; the fix of the v17 line was not backported to v16.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L3, on js@16.3.0 - 16.4.1 and js@17.2.0 - 17.2.1.
evidence.post_fix: js@17.3.0 and js@17.4.0 throw on the same values.
evidence.expected_basis: The ScMap carries distinct keys of different ScVal types (CAP-46); a lossless conversion must keep each.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 15 of 15 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0018.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added. The 16.x maintenance line receives critical security fixes only (js-stellar-sdk SECURITY.md); no backport request is drafted unless a maintainer decides to ask for one.
